predict.question: Your guitar teacher lists eight identified errors in your playing. You fix exactly one per practice round and make no new ones. After four rounds, how many errors remain?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: Peak emphasizes targeted practice with informative feedback rather than repetition alone.
modelBoundary: Repeating unchanged leaves {A}; correcting one per round leaves {B}. Only the specified correction operation removes errors.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Real feedback may not be understood, errors may recur, and correction rates are not fixed.
